'''Trandoshan desh gauntlets''' were an item of heavy [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were made from [[Desh/Legends|desh]] and were [[black]] in [[Color/Legends|color]] with various metal plating attached.
